title: Silas and the Verdict
author: Lena Zhou
blurb: Ulyana Nakamura, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
